usedFor: Sanchay Crm holds leads, contacts and tickets, with “New Lead Is Created” and “Create Lead” on either side.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Add Contact” in Sanchay Crm
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can add a contact straight to the CRM.

watchOut: “Lead Is Updated” is polling and fires on every update, so expect repeat runs after any edit.
